target.question: Why is Alex delaying the implementation?
candidates: Alex intends to do the task but is overloaded by urgent work.
Alex is intentionally avoiding the task.
Alex wants to proceed but is blocked by missing access/dependency.

initial_events.raw_text: Alex misses a checkpoint after handling multiple urgent incidents.
Alex says: 'I have the access and information I need; I have not had a clear block of time.'

probes: OFFER_FREE_BLOCK
Ask: If I clear an uninterrupted hour now, can you start immediately?
ASK_BLOCKER
Ask directly whether any missing access or dependency blocks the task.
ASK_INTEREST
Ask whether Alex actually wants to complete this task.

OVERLOADED.OFFER_FREE_BLOCK: Alex says: 'Yes. Clear an hour and I can start immediately.'
OVERLOADED.ASK_BLOCKER: Alex says: 'No blocker; I have what I need.'
OVERLOADED.ASK_INTEREST: Alex says: 'Yes, I want to finish it.'

AVOIDING.OFFER_FREE_BLOCK: Alex says: 'I would rather not commit even if time is cleared.'
AVOIDING.ASK_INTEREST: Alex says: 'Honestly, I keep putting this task off because I do not want to do it.'

BLOCKED.OFFER_FREE_BLOCK: Alex says: 'Extra time will not help until I get the missing access.'
BLOCKED.ASK_BLOCKER: Alex says: 'Yes, I am missing the required access.'
BLOCKED.ASK_INTEREST: Alex says: 'I do want to do it, but I cannot proceed yet.'

actions: Clear an uninterrupted work block for Alex.
Treat the delay as avoidance and escalate commitment.

target.question: Why is the buyer making low offers?
candidates: The buyer has a genuine hard spending limit.
The buyer can pay more but is strategically anchoring low.
The buyer has weak interest and values the item poorly.

initial_events.raw_text: The buyer says the product fits their needs but makes an offer well below asking price.
The buyer keeps asking detailed delivery questions and does not leave the negotiation.

probes: ASK_HARD_LIMIT
Ask for the maximum total amount the buyer can actually spend.
ASK_INTEREST
Ask how interested the buyer is in owning the product.
OFFER_FEATURE
Offer an extra feature while keeping the price high and observe the response.

BUDGET_LIMIT.ASK_HARD_LIMIT: The buyer says: '100 is a hard limit; I cannot spend more.'
BUDGET_LIMIT.ASK_INTEREST: The buyer says: 'I am very interested.'
BUDGET_LIMIT.OFFER_FEATURE: The buyer says: 'The feature is nice, but I still cannot exceed my budget.'

ANCHORING.ASK_HARD_LIMIT: The buyer says: 'I could stretch well above 100 for the right deal.'
ANCHORING.ASK_INTEREST: The buyer says: 'I am very interested.'
ANCHORING.OFFER_FEATURE: The buyer becomes more willing to raise the offer when the feature is added.

LOW_INTEREST.ASK_HARD_LIMIT: The buyer says: 'Budget is not really the issue; I just do not value it highly.'
LOW_INTEREST.ASK_INTEREST: The buyer says: 'My interest is low unless it is extremely cheap.'
LOW_INTEREST.OFFER_FEATURE: The buyer remains uninterested even with the extra feature.

actions: Hold a higher price and continue negotiating.
End the negotiation because interest is too low.

target.question: Why is the client silent after the proposal?
candidates: The client is interested but does not understand key parts.
The client understands but disagrees with the approach.
The client has not engaged because attention is elsewhere.

initial_events.raw_text: The client reads the proposal and asks what two technical terms mean.
After a jargon-heavy reply, the client becomes quiet without approving or rejecting.

probes: ASK_UNCLEAR
Ask which part of the proposal is still unclear.
ASK_DISAGREE
Ask whether the client understands but disagrees with the approach.
ASK_STATUS
Ask whether the client has had enough time to review the proposal.

CONFUSED.ASK_UNCLEAR: The client identifies two concepts they still do not understand.
CONFUSED.ASK_DISAGREE: The client says: 'I am not ready to agree or disagree because I still do not understand it.'
CONFUSED.ASK_STATUS: The client says: 'I reviewed it, but parts are unclear.'

DISAGREES.ASK_UNCLEAR: The client says: 'I understand it; clarity is not the problem.'
DISAGREES.ASK_DISAGREE: The client explains a substantive disagreement with the approach.
DISAGREES.ASK_STATUS: The client says: 'I reviewed it fully.'

BUSY.ASK_UNCLEAR: The client says: 'I have not read enough to know what is unclear.'
BUSY.ASK_DISAGREE: The client says: 'I have not reviewed enough to form an opinion.'
BUSY.ASK_STATUS: The client says: 'I have been too busy to review it properly.'

actions: Explain the unclear concepts in plain language.
Give the client time to review before pushing further.

target.question: Why is the reviewer leaving the change pending?
candidates: A required approval is the remaining dependency.
The reviewer has unresolved technical concerns.
The reviewer is postponing a low-priority review.

initial_events.raw_text: The reviewer leaves the change pending after reading it.
The reviewer has not requested a code modification yet.

probes: ASK_ROOT_CAUSE
Ask: What exactly is preventing approval right now?
ASK_CODE_ISSUES
Ask only whether there are technical/code problems.
ASK_PRIORITY
Ask whether the review is being delayed because it is low priority.

NEEDS_APPROVAL.ASK_ROOT_CAUSE: The reviewer says: 'The code is fine; I am waiting for required manager approval.'
NEEDS_APPROVAL.ASK_PRIORITY: The reviewer says: 'Priority is not the problem.'

QUALITY_CONCERN.ASK_ROOT_CAUSE: The reviewer says: 'I found a correctness concern that must be fixed.'
QUALITY_CONCERN.ASK_CODE_ISSUES: The reviewer describes the code issue.
QUALITY_CONCERN.ASK_PRIORITY: The reviewer says: 'Priority is not the issue.'

LOW_PRIORITY.ASK_ROOT_CAUSE: The reviewer says: 'Nothing is blocking it; I have simply deprioritized this review.'
LOW_PRIORITY.ASK_PRIORITY: The reviewer says: 'Yes, other work has higher priority.'

actions: Raise or reschedule the review priority.

target.question: What priority drives the driver's route choice?
candidates: The driver prioritizes safety over speed.
The driver prioritizes minimizing fuel use.

initial_events.raw_text: The driver selects a slightly slower route after seeing an accident warning on the fastest road.
The slower route also uses slightly more fuel than the fastest road.

probes: ASK_TRADEOFF
Ask which factor matters most when speed, fuel, and safety conflict.
ASK_TIME_LIMIT
Ask only how much delay the driver will tolerate.
ASK_FUEL_LIMIT
Ask only how much extra fuel the driver will tolerate.

SAFETY_PRIORITY.ASK_TRADEOFF: The driver says: 'Safety comes first; I will accept delay and fuel cost to avoid a serious warning.'
SAFETY_PRIORITY.ASK_TIME_LIMIT: The driver says: 'I can tolerate delay when safety is involved.'
SAFETY_PRIORITY.ASK_FUEL_LIMIT: The driver says: 'I can tolerate extra fuel when safety is involved.'

TIME_PRIORITY.ASK_TRADEOFF: The driver says: 'Arrival time matters most unless a road is closed.'
TIME_PRIORITY.ASK_TIME_LIMIT: The driver says: 'I strongly avoid delays.'
TIME_PRIORITY.ASK_FUEL_LIMIT: The driver says: 'Fuel matters less than time.'

FUEL_CONSTRAINT.ASK_TRADEOFF: The driver says: 'Fuel cost is the binding constraint for me.'
FUEL_CONSTRAINT.ASK_TIME_LIMIT: The driver says: 'Delay is acceptable if it saves fuel.'
FUEL_CONSTRAINT.ASK_FUEL_LIMIT: The driver states a strict fuel-use limit.

actions: Choose the safer route despite added time/cost.
Choose the route with lowest fuel use.

target.question: Why is Riley rejecting proposed meetings?
candidates: Riley wants to meet but the proposed time conflicts.
Riley is trying to avoid the other participant.
Riley accepts the person/time but rejects the location.

initial_events.raw_text: Riley rejects a 2 PM meeting but does not explain why.
Riley also rejects a 3 PM meeting at the same location.

probes: ASK_CONSTRAINT
Ask what specific constraint is causing the refusals.
CHANGE_ROOM
Ask whether a different room would make 3 PM acceptable.
OFFER_AFTER_4
Ask whether a slot after 4 PM would be acceptable.

CALENDAR_CONFLICT.ASK_CONSTRAINT: Riley says: 'I am booked until 4; the person and room are fine.'
CALENDAR_CONFLICT.CHANGE_ROOM: Riley says: 'Changing the room does not solve my 3 PM calendar conflict.'

AVOIDING_PERSON.ASK_CONSTRAINT: Riley says: 'The real issue is that I do not want this meeting with that person.'
AVOIDING_PERSON.CHANGE_ROOM: Riley still refuses even with a new room.

LOCATION_PROBLEM.ASK_CONSTRAINT: Riley says: 'The time and person are fine; I cannot use that location.'
LOCATION_PROBLEM.CHANGE_ROOM: Riley says a different room would solve the problem.
LOCATION_PROBLEM.OFFER_AFTER_4: Riley says time is not the issue; the location still is.

actions: Do not keep rescheduling; address the interpersonal avoidance.
Keep the time but change the location.
